segments.text: Good morning everyone, let's do a quick standup. Bob, you want to start?
Sure. Yesterday I finished the database migration script and deployed it to staging. It's looking solid.
Today I'll be writing unit tests for the migration and then picking up the auth module story.
I'm blocked on getting the Supabase service role key from DevOps. Dan, can you send that over by end of day?
Absolutely, I'll send the Supabase service role key to you by 5 PM today.
Great. Carol, your turn.
Yesterday I completed the design mockups for the meeting room page. I shared them in Figma, please review when you can.
Today I'm starting on the summary page design. I expect to have a first draft ready by EOD.
No blockers on my end.
Perfect. I'll review your Figma mockups this afternoon, Carol, and leave comments.
Yesterday I had syncs with the client and stakeholders. They confirmed go-live is March 28th — that's our hard deadline, team.
Today I'm drafting the deployment checklist and then reaching out to Vercel support about our bandwidth limit on the Hobby plan.
Quick question — do we need to write end-to-end tests before the March 28th go-live, or is that a stretch goal?
Good question. Let's make end-to-end tests a hard requirement. Bob, can you own that along with Carol?
Yep, Carol and I will pair on end-to-end tests. We'll target having them done by March 25th.
Agreed, March 25th works for me.
One more thing — I noticed the LiveKit token endpoint isn't rate-limited yet. We should add rate limiting before go-live.
Good catch Dan. Dan, please add rate limiting to the LiveKit token endpoint by March 22nd.
Will do, I'll have rate limiting on the token endpoint done by March 22nd.
Alright, anything else before we wrap? Any open questions?
Still not sure who handles load testing after the release. Should we loop in the DevOps team?
Let's leave that as an open question for now and decide in Monday's planning session.
Great standup everyone. Let's have a great day and hit that March 28th deadline!

visualNotes.description: Shared screen showing project timeline — go-live circled on March 28th.
